_id.description: Unique identifier for the video, likely an ObjectId.

tags.description: List of tags associated with the video.

guides.description: List of guides/presenters in the video.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the video was published.

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds.

private.description: Indicates if the video is private or public.

endCutout.description: Cutout time in seconds from the end of the video.

difficultyScore.description: A numerical score representing the video's difficulty.

soundQuality.description: Quality of the sound in the video.

seriesId.description: Identifier for the series this video belongs to, if any.

hasAccess.description: Indicates if the user has access to this video.

hostingId.description: Identifier for the video on the hosting platform (e.g., YouTube ID).

description.description: A brief description of the video content.

audioDownload.description: URL to download the audio of the video.

sources.description: Source URLs for the video content.

episodeNumber.description: Episode number if the video is part of a series (optional).

subtitles.description: Subtitles for the video, typically in WebVTT format (optional).
